what: Real-browser audio-event proof for the Car Mode cut-off-reply fix. Case A drives the actual product playback leaf (playClip) on a real <audio> element with a real 1.2s WAV clip and records the audio-event timeline. Case B deliberately clobbers one element to prove the instrument would catch a clobber (so Case A is not a vacuous pass).
browser: Chrome 150 on Windows (browser-harness, trusted CDP click as the user gesture)

caseA.meaning: The reverted single-clip path plays the ENTIRE reply from play to ended with exactly one src assignment and NO src change before ended - the whole reply is heard.

caseB.meaning: A deliberate second src assignment at 183ms - while clip 1 is still playing - is detected, and no ended ever fires for the clobbered clip. This is exactly the failure mode Case A rules out, proving Case A's assertion has teeth.

timeline.event: src= (CLOBBER - clip 1 still playing, no ended yet)
